name: Malaysian Conservation Alliance for Tigers (MYCAT)
legalName: Programmes administered by Wildlife Society of Selangor (WILD)
summary: Coordinate government and NGO action to save the Malayan tiger, with on-the-ground protection and habitat restoration around Taman Negara.
programmes: Community Ranger patrols with Orang Asli (Bateq) community
impact: 128 ha next to Sungai Yu viaduct gazetted as forest reserve (2019)
7,462 native saplings planted, rangers patrolled 8,000+ km and disarmed 103 snares (2020-2021, GlobalGiving report Oct 2021)
beneficiaries: Malayan tigers and their habitat; Orang Asli communities employed in protection and restoration

organisation.founders: Alliance founded by DWNP Peninsular Malaysia, Malaysian Nature Society, TRAFFIC and WWF-Malaysia; Dr Kae Kawanishi described as founder in Current Conservation (2020)

taxExemption.statement: Not stated (only US tax-deductibility via GlobalGiving and UK Gift Aid mentioned)

organisation.accounts: Annual reports 2009-2015 listed at https://mycat.my/reports; nothing newer found

contact.address: Unit T3-16-15, 3 Towers, Jalan Ampang, 50450 Kuala Lumpur (field office: Kampung Kubang Rusa, Merapoh, Lipis, Pahang)

live.note: No live or video channel found on site

donationsToday: Online form (one-time/monthly/yearly, RM10-RM500 or custom), bank transfer to Wildlife Society of Selangor (Maybank), GlobalGiving for international donors
